offering_description.value: Rush Street Interactive offers online casino games, sports betting and poker to players in regulated markets. It runs these services through its own websites and apps and operates gaming and sportsbook services for casino and lottery partners.

primary_services.value: online casino gaming; online sports betting; online poker; retail sportsbook operations; free-to-play social casino gaming

end_markets.value: online casino gambling; sports betting; online poker; social casino gaming

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Casino and sportsbook wagers generate gaming proceeds, while poker players pay fees to play; project or contract: Casino and lottery partners contract for gaming platform and sportsbook operations

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Combines its own software, game content and sports data to deliver online gambling to players; service provider: Uses partner venues and gaming licenses to run gambling services for casinos and lottery agencies
